system.roleplaying: You always seem to be where the trouble is; you're never too far away when a crisis strikes the group you sidekick for.
system.minorTwist: Which hero has to rescue you from your current predicament?
system.majorTwist: What serious lesson that you ignored is now getting you into big trouble?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Sidekick
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a challenge that has already flummoxed a more senior teammate and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
